question: Compare the top three open-source vector databases for a startup building RAG products.
stop_detail: All required criteria have supporting evidence.

short_answer.text: Qdrant, Weaviate and Milvus are reasonable open-source vector database candidates to shortlist for a startup’s RAG product, rather than a definitive ranked top three. All three are described as supporting hybrid search and flexible deployment; Weaviate also has documented LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations in the reviewed evidence. The main uncertainties are their exact licenses, comparative adoption and workload-specific performance.

key_findings.text: The selection is based on their inclusion in a vector database comparison and their documented RAG-relevant features, not a measured adoption ranking. Adoption figures were not found.
All three are described as open-source vector databases, but the reviewed evidence does not identify their licenses.

All three are described as supporting hybrid search and metadata filtering. The reviewed evidence names LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations for Weaviate, but does not establish comparable integration coverage for the other two.

Qdrant is a candidate to test for frequently updated workloads; the reviewed article says it handles frequent updates well, while Milvus needs an index rebuild for optimal performance after large bulk updates.
Milvus is a candidate for larger-scale workloads, but a reviewed guide says it requires engineering resources. Weaviate and Qdrant also have managed and self-hosted options.
Benchmark the shortlist on the startup’s own data, filters, update patterns and tail-latency targets before choosing.
